protocol.purpose: Protocol-frozen evaluation of additional-trial efficiency on public physical-experiment datasets that were not used by the v2 development benchmark.

freeze.result_policy: A full result is valid only after status is frozen, both revisions identify the preceding committed candidate, and evaluation_fingerprint matches the algorithm, data, dependency lock, evaluator, and normalized protocol.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed prevalence rule for method evaluation; not an engineering specification.

mechanism_features.name: reynolds_proxy
mechanism_features.basis: Velocity-length product preserves the ordering of Reynolds number when fluid properties are fixed.

mechanism_features.name: frequency_chord
mechanism_features.basis: Intermediate term for a reduced-frequency proxy.

mechanism_features.name: reduced_frequency_proxy
mechanism_features.basis: Frequency-length divided by velocity is a dimensionless aerodynamic similarity term.

mechanism_features.name: relative_displacement_thickness
mechanism_features.basis: Boundary-layer displacement thickness relative to chord length.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed prevalence rule for method evaluation; not an engineering specification.

mechanism_features.name: froude_squared
mechanism_features.basis: Wave-making resistance has a nonlinear dependence on Froude number.

mechanism_features.name: slenderness_interaction
mechanism_features.basis: Interaction between two dimensionless hull-slenderness descriptors.

mechanism_features.name: fullness_draught_interaction
mechanism_features.basis: Interaction between hull fullness and beam-draught geometry.

claim_boundary.permitted_if_passed: On the protocol-frozen public physical-experiment evaluation, Ingot required fewer additional result queries than every preregistered baseline while preserving the success-rate guardrail.
not_permitted: The same reduction applies to another factory, process, material, machine, objective, or experiment cost.
Offline pool replay proves prospective production-cycle reduction.
Mechanism features are validated physical laws or confirmed causes.
